title: A Prom for the Scholarship
author: Silas Okafor
blurb: Paloma Sterling, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
